title: Phase 01 — Main Menu
summary: Requirements for the main menu: loading and title screens, ship and level select, placeholder game screen, and keyboard, gamepad and touch navigation.
notes: Path under specs/ gives a strong SPEC signal. Content is mostly PRD-style (P01-Rxx MUST/SHOULD/MAY requirements, acceptance criteria, goals, out of scope), with some technical content (state machine, cookie storage interface, test API). Ambiguity resolved by path signal per the SPEC-over-PRD precedence rule. Output filename uses the placeholder suffix NOHASH because no hashing tool was available to compute the 8-char SHA-256 prefix of the source path; the hash must be recomputed before the synthesizer relies on the filename convention.
